channel.title: Blueprint AI Studio - Project progress
channel.description: Dated public progress for Blueprint AI Studio, its LMS and From Blueprint to Application.

item.title: CBE and CBE-IX added to the reader labs
item.description: The Rules, Authority & Enforcement reader labs now include CBE and CBE-IX boundary-design exercises. Two new method profiles bring the site to 20 methods, with composition examples added to the 18 earlier profiles.

item.title: When a Rule Is Not a Control
item.description: Published a technical guide on separating instruction, authority, enforcement, verification and preservation when AI agents can change real state, including bounded behavioural evidence from the implementation case.

item.title: Rules, Authority & Enforcement reader labs
item.description: Shipped interactive synthetic reader labs for exploring the difference between an instruction, actual authority, enforcement, verification and preservation in agentic systems, with dedicated browser interaction checks.
